::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 25th [1869]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS New York Public Library, De Coursey Fales Collection/4[^1]
:::

My dear Miss [name deliberately obscured][^2]
I hope I am not tormenting you but on account of other engagements I am anxious to know whether you could come this week or next. The week that begins with the 7th and has Ash Wednesday in it, I am going to spend at [Mr Wilson](people/person_1541.qmd)’s but the one after that I shall be at home again if that suited you better than within the next fortnight

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper, endorsed ‘1869’.
[^2]: Possibly [Elizabeth Missing Sewell](people/person_1301.qmd), a number of whose letters from CMY are marked in this way.
